# M-VAVE Chocolate TUI

> Linux terminal UI that reads and writes M-VAVE Chocolate and Chocolate Plus
> footswitch settings over USB MIDI (Jieli vendor SysEx). Read-only until
> started with --write; each write is acknowledged and read back.

## Docs
- Landing: https://wilsonnet.github.io/mvave-chocolate-tui/
- Overview: https://wilsonnet.github.io/mvave-chocolate-tui/overview/
- Install: https://wilsonnet.github.io/mvave-chocolate-tui/install/
- First run: https://wilsonnet.github.io/mvave-chocolate-tui/first-run/
- Protocol: https://wilsonnet.github.io/mvave-chocolate-tui/reference/protocol/
- CLI: https://wilsonnet.github.io/mvave-chocolate-tui/reference/cli/
- Troubleshooting: https://wilsonnet.github.io/mvave-chocolate-tui/reference/troubleshooting/

## Install
curl -fsSL https://github.com/WilsonNet/mvave-chocolate-tui/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash -s -- --run
